{{Top|leg}}
The '''bio-energy array''' was a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used by the [[Qektoth Confederation]] and, like many of their designs, it was a biological creation. The array fired a blue lightning-like blast that was capable of piercing conventional shields in a manner similar to [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. However, it required a large amount of power and as a result, [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] strength would often suffer when the weapon fired. The weapon was mounted on their [[Qektoth attack cruiser]]s, and was the cruiser's main weapon.
